examples.scenario: An attacker uses an AI-generated deepfake audio call impersonating the CFO to instruct the finance team to transfer $250,000 to a fraudulent overseas account. The attacker supplements the call with a spear-phishing email containing a voice message link and requests urgent wire transfer, bypassing normal verification processes.

SMTP logs showing legitimate SPF and DKIM passes but delivered to finance@partnercorp.com
Network capture showing encrypted TLS traffic with audio/wav content-type
Finance system log showing wire transfer bypassing two-factor authorization
Domain ovbkus33-bank.com registered 2 weeks prior with privacy protection
URL with domain mimicking SWIFT code and random token query parameters
Deepfake audio detection tool flags high confidence of synthetic voice
examples.detection_method: Deploy deepfake detection engines on received audio files and voice call recordings; correlate wire transfer requests with multi-factor verification logs; monitor email headers for domain spoofing; implement behavioral analytics to flag unusual transaction patterns; train employees to verify unusual instructions via secondary communication channels; use DNS and SSL certificate monitoring for suspicious domain registrations.
